# Merenga

> Independent brand building agency — strategy, visual systems and communication for fashion, beauty and lifestyle brands. Based in Amsterdam, working with projects worldwide.

Merenga builds brands end to end: from research and positioning to identity, design and communication. The studio works with fashion, beauty and lifestyle brands, combining strategic thinking with a strong visual and aesthetic craft.

## Pages
- [Home](https://merengabbs.com/): full-screen brand film and entry to the studio.
- [About](https://merengabbs.com/about.html): positioning, manifesto, how the studio builds brands, what it does, and the team.
- [Projects](https://merengabbs.com/projects.html): selected work.
- [FAQ](https://merengabbs.com/faq.html): common questions about the agency and the brands and categories it works with.
- [Contact](https://merengabbs.com/contact.html): get in touch — elena@merengabbs.com.

## What we do
- Research & Insight — audience, market and category understanding.
- Strategy & Positioning — brand platform, positioning and direction.
- Identity & Design — visual identity and design systems.
- Communication & Activation — content, campaigns and launch communication.

## Selected projects
- Vilhelm Perfumerie — creative direction & production for a new product launch (Dear Lord ADV).
- Rafaello × Charmstore — collaboration management and art direction of the launch campaign.
- Agent Provocateur — PR & communication support of a flagship store opening in Kazakhstan.
- Karen Khachanov × MR — creative direction and production of an ADV campaign.
- Ginger 9 — branding.
- Sigma Club — branding & logo (sport · bien-être · kids).

## FAQ
- What is Merenga? — Merenga is an independent brand building agency based in Amsterdam, working with fashion, beauty and lifestyle brands. We build brands end to end — from research and positioning to identity, design and launch communication.
- What does Merenga do? — Five connected areas: Research & Insight, Strategy & Positioning, Identity & Design, Communication & Activation, and Market Entry & Sales. We can take a brand through the whole journey or plug into a single stage — from understanding the market and defining the strategy to building the brand, launching it, and developing the right wholesale and distribution partnerships.
- Where is Merenga based and where do you work? — Amsterdam, working with projects internationally.
- What kind of brands do you work with? — Fashion, beauty, fragrance, lifestyle, sport and wellness, and retail — from new launches to established brands.
- How do you start a project? — Email elena@merengabbs.com with a few words about your brand and goals.
- Do you do branding for a perfume or fragrance brand? — Yes. We handle creative direction and production for fragrance launches — for example, the Dear Lord launch for Vilhelm Perfumerie.
- Can you brand or launch a beauty brand? — Yes. Positioning, identity and launch communication for beauty and lifestyle brands, such as the Ginger 9 nail studio identity.
- Do you work with lingerie or fashion retail, including store openings? — Yes. We led PR and communication for the Agent Provocateur flagship store opening in Kazakhstan.
- Can you handle a brand collaboration or an FMCG / food campaign? — Yes. We manage collaborations and art-direct launch campaigns — for example, Rafaello × Charmstore.
- Do you brand sport, wellness or kids brands? — Yes. Brand platform and logo systems for sport, wellness and kids — for example, Sigma Club (sport · bien-être · kids).
- Do you produce advertising campaigns with athletes or public figures? — Yes. Creative direction and production of ADV campaigns, including with athletes — for example, Karen Khachanov × MR.
- Can you run a full launch campaign — from idea to production? — Yes. We cover creative direction and production end to end, as with Vilhelm Perfumerie and Karen Khachanov × MR.
